property.title: Remodeled beachside home between the river and the ocean
property.description: Sought-after 3 bed / 2 bath with a large primary suite and en-suite bath, set between the Intracoastal Waterway (Halifax River) and the ocean. Remodeled kitchen and upgraded baths make this a rare gem. Fully enclosed back porch gives much-needed open space for flexible use. Out back there is a paver patio and a fully fenced yard.

similar.title: Beautifully remodeled near Tanger Outlets
similar.description: A beautifully remodeled home so close to everything! Just down the street are the Tanger Outlets, restaurants, and I-95 — everything Daytona and Ormond Beach have to offer in less than 5 minutes each way.

similar.title: End-unit townhome with stone fireplace and hot tub
similar.description: Beautiful end-unit townhome featuring 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a spacious open-concept design. Added privacy and a larger yard than most. Outdoors, a stunning stone fireplace creates the perfect setting for cozy evenings, plus an included hot tub and a covered lanai off the primary bedroom. Can come furnished or unfurnished.

similar.title: Pool home with whole-house generator in Palm Coast
similar.description: Centrally located to everything in Palm Coast. Three nicely sized bedrooms, two baths, fully updated kitchen with high-end stainless appliances, an oversized 2-car garage, and an inground pool that heats and COOLS. A hot tub under a covered gazebo and plenty of privacy in the fenced backyard make this an entertainer's dream. Built-in whole-house Generac generator and custom plantation shutters throughout.
